title: Why Your $12 Burger Costs $28 on DoorDash
alts: DoorDash Fees Explained: Where Your $28 Actually Goes
The Restaurant Gets $11. The App Gets $8. You Pay $28.
line1: Why is DoorDash so expensive? A $12 burger became $28. Here's every hidden fee, who gets each slice, and how to pay less.
summary: Dave orders a $12 burger on a delivery app and the total says $28. We read the receipt line by line: the hidden menu markup (apps charge restaurants 15-30% commission, so many raise app prices), the delivery fee, the 15% service fee, the small order fee, the regulatory response fee, taxes and the tip. Then we slice the $28 like a pizza to see who really gets what, zoom out to DoorDash's Q2 2026 numbers (970 million orders, a 13.5% take rate, about 21 cents of profit per order), do the DashPass subscription math, and finish with simple ways to pay less.
